quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER sees continued positive order momentum and (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 release additions to the call: 4'488 employees at the end of June (prior year 4'058), the majority of the increase from higher staffing for OCS, with 1'204 in Switzerland; net liquidity CHF 146.1 million; EMEA 60% of sales (prior year 54%), Asia-Pacific 19% and the Americas 21%. Transportation segment: order intake CHF 161.0 million (+10.4%), net sales CHF 135.6 million (-0.9%), EBIT margin 9.0%. The large OCS orders from an operator of hyperscaler infrastructures secured in 2025 made a first sales contribution, and the Data Center growth initiative is expected to see a significant increase in sales from the second half of 2026 based on the existing OCS order backlog.
